name: Teach the Machine
blurb: Switch features on and off for a small, patient learning machine, press Train, and open up every wrong answer to see exactly which feature fooled it. A toy with invented data, not a claim about larger systems. Working title.
status: Milestones 1 to 3 and 5 of 7 built (not finished: shelves 4 and 5, the hint ladder, achievements and the Desktop boot are still to come): switch features on and off for a small learning machine called Pip, press Train, press Test, and open every wrong answer in a Why panel (24 lessons on three shelves, every lesson proved clearable by trying every set of switches, a Failure Notebook, the standard kit, 240 tests). Invented data only, nothing timed or lost. Hub-linked, no BCM tag
